description: Enterprise Online Fraud Detection and Account Takeover Standard Operating Procedure

rules.name: High-Risk Foreign IP with Unrecognized Device
rules.description: Session originated from high-risk foreign jurisdiction on previously unseen device hardware signature.

rules.name: Severe Spend Deviation (>3.0x Average)
rules.description: Transaction amount significantly exceeds historic 90-day baseline spending profile.

rules.name: Anonymizing Proxy / Tor Exit / VPN Telemetry
rules.description: Network telemetry indicates masked identity or low-trust emulator/proxy environment.

rules.name: Rapid Cash Dispersion on New Account
rules.description: Young account exhibiting rapid layering/dispersion velocity indicative of money mule activity.

rules.name: Unverified Beneficiary Outbound Transfer
rules.description: High value IMPS/RTGS/Wire transfer attempted without stepped-up hardware or biometric authentication.

rules.name: Recent Credential Reset Preceding Outbound Activity
rules.description: Investigator/system notes confirm password/MFA update within 48 hours prior to transaction.

rules.name: High-Velocity UPI Transfer via New or Emulated Device
rules.description: UPI payment initiated from unrecognized mobile device identifier or proxy environment.

rules.name: SIM Reissuance within 24-Hour Cooling Window
rules.description: High-value fund dispatch on newly activated device within mandatory 24-hour telecom cooling period.

rules.name: Hardware-Backed Biometric Authentication Verified
rules.description: Transaction was verified with strong biometric hardware assertion (FaceID / Fingerprint).

rules.name: Active Verified Travel Notice on Record
rules.description: Customer proactively notified customer service of international travel to the destination country.

rules.name: Long Established Tenure with Zero Fraud Dispositions
rules.description: Established account relationship with over 2 years of clean history and zero confirmed fraud incidents.

rules.name: Recent Customer Service Confirmation Call
rules.description: Customer voice-verified the pending transaction via inbound customer care call with clean voice biometric.
